evidence_contract.source-observed: A passage was read in a local literary source; this is not direct author adoption or empirical corroboration.
evidence_contract.user-approved: A direction explicitly recorded in the central current-plan authority file.
evidence_contract.editorial-proposal: A continuity design, sequence, limit or event construction awaiting adoption.
evidence_contract.unknown: Not established; never silently converted to zero, impossibility or equivalence.
evidence_contract.material_effect: A change perceptible within a scene, not a requirement that physical matter or measured time precede its introduction.
evidence_contract.quote_policy: Short exact excerpts from inspected local manuscripts; attributions inside those manuscripts are not automatically authenticated author words.

sources.quote: The Mother holds. I PROTECT what she holds.
sources.scope: Lilith describes distinct roles and a partnership with Mother; no identity merger is stated

observed_literary_claims: Codex Lilith describes herself and Mother as partners with different roles.
Father's account places embodied Lilith beside Adam in the Garden.
Mother's creation narrative is retrospectively addressed to a later Lilith.
V2 uses Mother-aspect language and separately leaves reincarnation/fragment/vessel as alternatives.
unresolved: Whether or how a Mother aspect is expressed by Lilith
Which continuity relation links modern Lily and Lilith
Whether the first chapter uses a later Lilith framing viewpoint
must_not_infer: Lilith equals Mother because she expresses an aspect
Garden embodiment proves Lilith had no other earlier mode of existence
Panoramic narration places every later witness physically inside the first moment
lilith_placement.first_chapter_requirement: Distinguish chronological embodied entry from retrospective framing presence; signal any later witness vantage.

stages.title: The Mother before an answer
stages.observer_boundary: Mother may experience holding and an unanswered address. Later recollection to Lilith is distinct from the original moment's knowledge.
knowledge_not_granted: Complete knowledge of every future independent response
A measured universal time before clocks are introduced
Another being's agreement from silence
stages.material_effect: An offered interval remains unfilled; its perceptibility need not be measured in seconds.

capability.proposed_limit: Leave an answer independent of the invitation
capability.cost: Unresolved expectation, not a quantified energy debt

stages.irreversible_consequence: Once independent response exists, guaranteeing future agreement would change the relation rather than reveal it was always free.
identity_uncertainties: Mother's awareness versus V2 original-consciousness language
Desire for an answer versus loneliness
Source or personification versus complete frame identity
stages.safe_disclosure: A limited encounter and changed condition are sufficient. Do not settle complete Omnoid geometry or omniscience.
failure_examples: Mother is described as lonely without acknowledging S2's contrary testimony.
Three measured seconds pass before any time convention is established.
Silence is treated as another person's consent.

stages.title: The First Flame wakes
stages.observer_boundary: A close viewpoint knows its fear, longing and expression; it may misread being held as absence.
knowledge_not_granted: Mother's identity before a recognition event
The entire source lineage from the fact of waking
Objective emptiness solely from perceived solitude
stages.material_effect: Light or warmth introduces perceptible contrast without presupposing electromagnetic equations.

capability.proposed_limit: Concentrate expression into an inhabitable encounter
capability.cost: Restraint and uncertainty; no adopted cosmic fuel budget

stages.irreversible_consequence: An expression has become encounterable and can have effects its source did not intend.
identity_uncertainties: Father as aspect of First Flame remains candidate
First as subjective awakening versus absolute priority
Lightbringer's later light does not establish source identity
stages.safe_disclosure: Name what the viewpoint experiences; reserve why it works and who surrounds it until evidence enters the scene.
failure_examples: First Flame identifies Mother immediately while retaining the nonrecognition origin.
The phrase original consciousness silently deletes Mother's prior awareness.
A proposed restraint limit is cited as an inherited physical equation.

stages.title: Distinction becomes relationship
stages.observer_boundary: Each can witness an uncommanded response. Shared origin does not supply unrestricted access to private intention.
knowledge_not_granted: That an apparent aspect is the whole source
That common origin entails ownership
That a later agreement was always predetermined
stages.material_effect: An address, refusal or unanswered question changes what the participants can expect from each other.

capability.inherited_vocabulary: A presence separate while described as part
capability.proposed_limit: Coordinate without dictating the other's answer

stages.irreversible_consequence: An independent answer becomes part of both histories; later coherence cannot retroactively make it forced or erase its occurrence.
identity_uncertainties: Separate identity versus perceptible aspect
Retrospective description of unity versus original knowledge
Whether a jointly held place is literal geography or a new scene construction
stages.safe_disclosure: Make refusal practicable before naming an agreement voluntary.
failure_examples: Part of me becomes a property claim treated as true.
Both speakers know private thoughts with no adopted mechanism.
Disagreement is resolved by identity merger that makes consent irrelevant.

stages.title: Divine children and unequal needs
stages.observer_boundary: A child can know its own need; parental descriptions are fallible. The new recorder reports observations and testimony, not unspoken motives.
knowledge_not_granted: Uniform motives for every Firstborn
A universal rate between unequal clocks
A predetermined vocation from origin or capacity
stages.material_effect: An office remains vacant, provision fails a recipient, or an appointment reveals clocks differ.

capability.inherited_vocabulary: Making companions and caring for them

stages.irreversible_consequence: A child's refusal or unmet need remains an event after later cooperation or successful provision.
identity_uncertainties: Firstborn immutability in S5 versus learning in S6
Which individual children are involved
Proposed recorder and steward are not inherited named beings
stages.safe_disclosure: Establish a particular child's limits before extrapolating to a class of beings.
failure_examples: All Firstborn are jealous in the same way.
The recorder reports a private thought as firsthand observation.
Absolute changelessness and acquired growth are both asserted without acknowledging the conflict.

stages.title: Misrecognition becomes an order
stages.observer_boundary: Identify the mistaken perceiver, endorsing authority, record-maker and recipient of an order separately.
knowledge_not_granted: Nonexistence from inability to perceive
An institution's perfect account of its own conduct
All divine motives from one observed official
stages.material_effect: A restriction closes an available path or interrupts provision for an identifiable recipient.

capability.proposed_limit: Orders operate through particular channels and enforcement
capability.cost: Lost access and injury borne by recipients as well as later responsibility for issuers

stages.irreversible_consequence: An order causes effects before its issuer understands them; correction cannot make the earlier harm never occur.
identity_uncertainties: Who specifically joins or resists the order
Lucifer's relation to the relevant Firstborn
Office, occupant and claimed source of authority
stages.safe_disclosure: Give readers enough evidence to recognize a mistake without narratorial omniscience about every actor.
failure_examples: Darkness itself is established as evil.
A divine seal proves legitimacy rather than only an authority claim.
Protective intent is used to cancel a recipient's actual loss.

stages.title: Separation and the missing place
stages.observer_boundary: Remaining witnesses perceive a failed reply or changed condition; absence alone does not reveal death, destination or private intention.
knowledge_not_granted: The missing person's destruction from silence
That voluntary departure and coerced retreat are the same event
The Hollow's complete nature from one grief account
stages.material_effect: Access, provision or reply changes. A usable departure threshold is a separate candidate action.

capability.inherited_vocabulary: Mother withdraws; Father separately describes avoidance
capability.proposed_limit: Keep departures distinct and preserve continuing outside conditions
capability.cost: Absence and the work required to maintain or rebuild relation

stages.irreversible_consequence: The interval apart remains real after reunion, including actions taken by those left without a reply.
identity_uncertainties: Mother retreat, children's departure and Father withdrawal are separate candidate events
Mother's proposed enduring loneliness versus S2 Not lonely
Hollow as grief, entropy, loneliness or an actor
Order of Father's withdrawal relative to Eden in different accounts
stages.safe_disclosure: Do not reveal an absent person's fate until a witness, trace or encounter supplies it.
failure_examples: Voluntary departure silently substitutes for the source's attack and retreat.
No reply is taken as proof of death.
Reunion resets the outside interval.
Grief or loneliness is treated as moral corruption.

stages.title: Bridge into Eden
stages.observer_boundary: A Garden witness encounters local soil, bodies and rules without automatically knowing their whole cosmological genealogy.
knowledge_not_granted: Verified Earth coordinates for Eden
A universal Threshold rate from the calibration bell
Later Lilith tradition as a passage of Genesis
stages.material_effect: Embodiment makes food, injury, shelter and distance consequential.

capability.inherited_vocabulary: A Garden where beings can grow and change
capability.proposed_limit: Local provision has conditions, distinct from its cosmic explanation
capability.cost: Embodied need; exact name-surrender and gate-clock mechanisms remain calibration proposals

stages.irreversible_consequence: A new home does not cancel preceding conflict; later departure does not erase what was experienced inside it.
identity_uncertainties: Clay creation versus called-forth new flames versus returning identity
Adam first versus Adam/Lilith at the same moment in S9
Father/Mother/Lilith relations remain separately indexed
Source collection identification is not passage-level research completion
stages.safe_disclosure: Introduce operative Garden conditions before explanatory lineage, and preserve distinct source traditions in the Codex apparatus.
failure_examples: Eden is placed at verified terrestrial coordinates without evidence.
A calibration bell's hour becomes a universal realm ratio.
Human creation silently proves Father/Mother/Lilith equivalence.
A later Lilith account is presented as a missing Genesis verse.

first_chapter_acceptance: Reader can identify an experienced want, an answer that cannot simply be commanded and a changed condition.
The viewpoint's present knowledge is distinguished from later recollection.
Mother's loneliness, omniscience and exact source identity are not silently decided.
Material language does not import measured physics or clocks before their introduction.
Humour arises from limitation, expectation or conduct; injury need not be dissolved by a quip.
A failed review cites an actual sentence and the unadopted rule it introduced.
dissent: The sequence is a proposal assembled from conflicting literary witnesses and the current chapter plan.
No older manuscript claim is upgraded to direct author endorsement.
The non-lonely Mother versus proposed enduring loneliness requires explicit selection or a narrated change.
Firstborn fixedness versus learning, and Adam first versus simultaneous creation, remain unresolved.
The Genesis source record remains catalogue-inspected, full-text-inspected false.
No theorem or physical truth is certified; first-safe chapters are proposed narrative disclosures.
